failure.title: A server-completed session still exposed duplicate submission controls
failure.note: The retained pre-fix predicate and regression show one Save and complete session control rendered for a session already returned as completed by the server after nine earlier checks passed.
failure.diagnosis: The route showed its completion notice for either local completion or server status, but hid the form only for completion performed in the current component instance. Reloading an already-completed session therefore presented contradictory read-only and submit states.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
